impact.text: Vault backing/surplus accounting and monitoring are unavailable while the stale slot remains registered.

precondition_sources.text: The Vault has an Accountant configured.
There is no active registration for the target BLP slot before supplyToBlp is called.
HyperCore leaves the 0x811 supplied-balance slot inactive after the accepted action.

intent_sources.text: Every registered slot must be an activated strict-read slot so that Accountant backing reads can dereference it.
